Package com.eloview.sdk.networkManager

Class NetworkConfig

java.lang.Object
com.eloview.sdk.networkManager.NetworkConfig
public class NetworkConfig extends Object
This is a model class which used to keep the network configuration data. It takes data from the user and provides it to the setNetwork API.
